notes.note: 9 tackles was the highlight for the game for Joel as he continues to show he can play at this level. He has been a great pick up this year.
Just 13 at 61% for Fitzgerald with this his second in the low 60s in the last three weeks.

Fitzgerald had the 19 at 68% which was a great turnaround from last week and inconsistency is what we are going to get from our rookies.
Fitzgerald found things a little tougher this week with just the 9 disposals at 33% and he gave away two free kicks. His lowest score by some distance.
Fitzgerald was fantastic with his 31 disposals. He is one you could loop with each round to try and get him on your field. He will be a popular stand in for owners of Horne-Francis.
Fitzgerald was ok with his 24 disposals but he had just 50% efficiency. He isn't the points machine we had hoped for but he is delivering enough for your bench.
